title: Implement Feature Flag for Analytics Event Tracking
description: PrismPocket is a complex mobile utility application with a mature feature set, including detailed user analytics. The product team wants to introduce a feature flag to give them more granular control over analytics events. This task will be performed in two stages, mimicking a common agile development workflow where configuration changes are deployed ahead of the feature logic.

project_spec.name: PrismPocket
project_spec.description:
PrismPocket is an "augmented utility sketchbook" that transforms everyday mobile tasks into color-rich, shareable micro-experiences. Instead of the classic notes-and-todos model, each captured item—whether text, photo, voice memo, or geotag—is rendered as a vibrant, swipeable "prism card" that users can remix with filters, brush-style annotations, and contextual stickers. Cards sync bidirectionally with a cloud workspace, where a real-time analytics engine surfaces creative trends (e.g., most-used color palettes, hotspot locations, mood score) and suggests artistic prompts.

Built entirely in Python but packaged natively for iOS and Android, the app layers Clean Architecture’s concentric rings atop an MVVM presentation shell. Domain entities such as PrismCard, PaletteMetric, and RemixSession remain pure and testable, while platform-specific adapters (CameraAdapter, BiometricAdapter, PushAdapter, etc.) bridge the boundary to native SDKs. An Observer bus streams state mutations from repositories to view-models, allowing live canvas updates and offline queue replay. The result is a utility that feels more like a pocket creative studio than a mundane organizer, distinguishing it sharply from conventional mobile_utility projects.

Whether users are scanning receipts, journaling travel, or capturing spur-of-the-moment doodles, PrismPocket reimagines utilitarian capture as an act of micro-creativity—complete with collaborative remixing, social drops, and data-driven inspiration.
